observations.behavior: Adds a fallback selection of an inner link or button when the primary SVG element lacks semantic meaning, and uses that selected element for tag identification.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes how click descriptions are generated in PostHog frontend event capture; this could improve accessibility and clarity of recorded user actions.

observations.behavior: Updates description generation to use the described element's text or aria-label rather than always using the first DOM node. This also adds a fallback to the original target if it has its own text/label while the described one does not.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows more accurate transcription of what was clicked by prioritizing meaningful labels over structural position, potentially improving downstream analysis and dashboards.

observations.behavior: Adds four new test cases covering SVGs with links, buttons, labeled images inside unlabeled parents, etc., asserting expected descriptive strings against autoCaptureEventToDescription.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection and documentation of behavior changes but is not itself a production capability improvement.

observations.limitations: Only two hunks provided: P1.F2.H1 contains implementation and tests, P1.F1.H1 only shows added assertions. No broader context on whether other callers depend on this function or whether compatibility checks exist elsewhere.

review.posthog_relevance: Could improve accessibility and clarity of frontend interaction descriptions shown in reports.
